description: This file defines the GameController class for managing game state, user interactions, and persistence in a Flutter-based chess application.

classes.name: GameController
classes.description: A controller class extending ChangeNotifier to manage chess game state, user interactions, and persistence.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads game settings and state from persistence, initializes game engine and updates internal state.

methods.name: _saveDebounced
methods.description: Saves game settings and state asynchronously without blocking UI.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Updates the board theme and persists the change.

methods.name: setFlipBoard
methods.description: Updates the board orientation and persists the change.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to initial state and clears persisted game data.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undoes the last move if possible and updates state.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Redoes the previously undone move if possible and updates state.

methods.name: tapSquare
methods.description: Handles user tap interactions on a square, selecting pieces or making moves.

methods.name: canDragFrom
methods.description: Checks if a piece can be dragged from a given square.

methods.name: beginDrag
methods.description: Initiates dragging a piece from a square, showing legal moves.

methods.name: dropOn
methods.description: Attempts to move a selected piece to a target square.

methods.name: _playMoveWithPromotionDefault
methods.description: Executes a move, defaulting to queen promotion if applicable, and updates state.

methods.name: moveList
methods.description: Returns the list of moves played in the game.
